Authenticity

Know it is genuine Mr. Supreme.

Look for these marks on the cloth before you buy.

  • 1
    The MR logoThe mountain-peak MR mark with the registered symbol, on our labels and our page.
  • 2
    The Mr. Supreme labelA black and white "MR. SUPREME" label sits on the fabric as it is folded and shown.
  • 3
    The width labelSupreme Shadda carries a black "MR" label with the 182 cm width.
  • 4
    The Mr. Polish tagEmbroidered lace carries the "MR. POLISH Embroidery ACME" tag.

The factory

Where the lace takes shape.

Mr. Supreme is a textile company. Our lace and embroidery are made on long multi-head embroidery machines, line after line, under one roof.

Rich texture, premium finish and a presence that fills the room. Made for kings who dress different.

Questions

Good to know

Why are prices not shown?

Price depends on the fabric and the quantity. Send your quote list and we reply on WhatsApp.

What size is the fabric?

Supreme Shadda is labelled 182 cm wide. Ask us the width and length of the fabric you want.

Do you sell retail and wholesale?

Both. Tell us which one you need when you send your quote list.

Where do you deliver?

Tell us your city when you send your quote list and we confirm delivery details.

Is there a minimum order?

Message us the quantity you have in mind and we confirm the minimum for that fabric.

Ready to stock Mr. Supreme?

Message us for the catalogue, colours and wholesale prices.
